text:
3.1.4 A2L File
With the information in the McSupport file an A2L file is generated. However, for this
generation the memory addresses for the variables and characteristics are needed.
They are usually extracted from the map file that is output by the linker of the ECU
executable. The exact process as well as the tool for the A2L file generation is not
standardized.
An example A2L file is provided in AUTOSAR_EXP_ModelingShowCases.zip.
